title: An item that changes only the workspace's own files cannot carry touches in a multi-repository workspace: check asks for repos, and repos refuses workspace (Nerthus adoption)
goal: In a workspace whose backlog.json declares repositories, an item whose touches are all workspace/<glob> is accepted with no repos, so a sprint sweep or a ledger task that edits only the workspace can be moved into an active sprint and dispatched; touches naming a declared repository still require repos

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', d])
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'r'))
open(os.path.join(d, 'backlog.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps({'repositories': {'r': 'r'}}))
b = [sys.executable, os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py'), '--root', d]
p = subprocess.run(b + ['new', 'story', '--title', 'workspace sweep', '--goal', 'g', '--check', "python3 _tools/check.py", '--touch', 'workspace/notes.md'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print('new refused:', (p.stdout + p.stderr)[-300:]); sys.exit(2)
i = p.stdout.split()[2]
p = subprocess.run(b + ['check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
bad = [l for l in (p.stdout + p.stderr).splitlines() if i in l and 'repos' in l]
print(len(bad), 'repos refusals of an item whose touches are all workspace/:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

Replaced with a repro that plants a two-repo workspace, files a story whose only touch is workspace/notes.md with a real check, and fails on the `touches without repos` error (bl_check.py:556); `set --repos workspace` is refused at bl_check.py:546. Check 0 guards the other clause and passes before the work by design: an item touching r/src/x.py with no repos is still refused. bl_dispatch and bl_land already treat an item with no repos as single-repository work.
